Sure! Here is the script for Game of Thrones Season 8, Episode 6, titled "The Final Storm". Title: The Final Storm

Episode 8, Season 6

[King's Landing, Day]

(Scene 1: The Red Keep)

Cersei (sitting on the Iron Throne, looking worried)

Cersei: (to Qyburn) The Night King's army is upon us. We must prepare.

Qyburn: My Queen, the Scorpions are ready. We have enough wildfire to burn the entire army.

Cersei: Good. Send Euron Greyjoy to Dragonstone. I want those dragons.

(Scene 2: Winterfell, Day)

(Jon, Daenerys, Tyrion, Sansa, Arya, Bran, and their armies are preparing for the battle against the Night King)

Tyrion: (to Jon) We have a plan. We'll form a phalanx around the Godswood. The dragons will take out the wights.

Jon: (to Daenerys) I'll lead the Dothraki and the Unsullied. You take the dragons.

Daenerys: (to Jon) I'll be by your side.

(Scene 3: The Wall, Night)

(Ghost, Tormund, and the Free Folk are guarding the Wall)

Tormund: (to Ghost) We'll hold the line, boy. For the Free Folk!

(Scene 4: Beyond the Wall, Night)

(The Night King, his army, and the White Walkers are marching towards Winterfell)

Night King: (to Viserion) Bring down the Wall.

(Viserion breathes blue fire, breaking a section of the Wall)

(Scene 5: King's Landing, Night)

(Euron Greyjoy arrives with the Iron Fleet)

Euron: (to Cersei) My Queen, I bring you a gift. The dragons are yours.

(Scene 6: Winterfell, Night)

(The battle begins. The Night King's army is overwhelming. The phalanx is holding, but the wights are breaking through)

Arya: (to Jon) I'll take out the Night King.

Jon: (to Arya) Be careful.

(Arya sneaks away)

(Scene 7: The Godswood, Night)

(The battle rages on. The dragons are taking out wights, but the Night King is still advancing)

(Arya appears behind the Night King)

Arya: (stabbing the Night King with her Valyrian steel dagger) I am Arya Stark of Winterfell. I came to bring you pain and death!

(The Night King turns to Arya, but she stabs him again, shattering into dust)

(Scene 8: The Godswood, Night)

(The battle ends. The living are victorious)

Jon: (to Daenerys) The Night King is dead. Our battle is won.

(Scene 9: King's Landing, Day)

(Cersei watches as Qyburn brings her a white raven)

Cersei: (to Qyburn) What does it say?

Qyburn: The war is over. Winterfell has fallen.

Cersei: (smiling) Then we shall march.

(Scene 10: Winterfell, Day)

(Jon, Daenerys, Sansa, Arya, and their armies are resting)

Tyrion: (to Jon) We must march south. Cersei will not give up her claim to the Iron Throne.

Jon: (to Daenerys) I must tell her the truth. I am Aegon Targaryen.

Daenerys: (to Jon) No. I will be the Queen of the Seven Kingdoms.

(Scene 11: King's Landing, Day)

(Cersei's army marches towards Winterfell)

(Scene 12: Winterfell, Day)

(Jon, Daenerys, Sansa, Arya, and their armies prepare for the final battle)

(To be continued...)

Title: Game of Thrones - Season 8, Episode 5 (Aired on HBO on May 12, 2019): "The Bells"

INT. WINTERFELL - GREAT HALL - DAY

The hall is bustling as the Northern lords and ladies discuss recent events. At the head of the table, SANSA STARK listens intently.

LORD UMBER
The wildlings report sightings of strange figures beyond the Wall.

SANSA
We must be vigilant. The North cannot afford to be caught off guard again.

LORD GLOVER
(leaning forward) What of Jon Snow? Has there been any word?

SANSA
A raven arrived this morning. He's still in King's Landing, negotiating with the Queen.

The lords murmur among themselves.

EXT. KING'S LANDING - RED KEEP - COURTYARD - DAY

JON SNOW and TYRION LANNISTER walk through the courtyard, deep in conversation.

JON
Daenerys' vision for the realm is noble, but the cost has been great. The people are weary, Tyrion.

TYRION
(pensively) Nobility often carries a heavy burden, Jon. But there are whispers among the smallfolk. They speak of a new dawn.

JON
A new dawn? Or another storm?

TYRION pauses, looking at the sky.

TYRION
Perhaps both. But we still have a chance to steer the winds in our favor.

INT. KING'S LANDING - THRONE ROOM - DAY

DAENERYS TARGARYEN stands before the Iron Throne, her expression resolute. VARYS approaches cautiously.

VARYS
Your Grace, the Lords of the Stormlands have declared for you. They see you as the rightful Queen.

DAENERYS
And the others?

VARYS
Still wavering, but many respect strength. The decision in the North could tip the scales.

DAENERYS
Then we must show them strength. We will march to Winterfell and remind them what true leadership looks like.

VARYS bows and exits silently. As he leaves, Daenerys gazes at the throne, her determination unwavering.

INT. WINTERFELL - GODSWOOD - NIGHT

ARYA STARK stands beneath the heart tree, her face somber. BRAN, sitting nearby, watches her thoughtfully.

BRAN
The world is changing, Arya. Our paths are shrouded, but we must forge them anew.

ARYA
(smirking) Paths are meant to be walked, Bran. Not foretold.

BRAN
(smiles faintly) True. But the whisper of the old gods still guides us, even in silence.

The wind rustles through the leaves of the heart tree as they stand in the quiet of the godswood.

FADE OUT.

THE END.

- He realizes that he has been missing for weeks and wonders if it's because he's been injured or lost somewhere.

- The next scene shows Jon being taken away by guards to Winterfell, where he meets other members of the Stark family and learns about their history and traditions.

- The episode then shifts to the Stark family, where Jon faces off against Cersei Lannister and her army. The Stark men fight bravely but ultimately fail to take on the enemy forces, which leads to Jon being captured and imprisoned.

- The episode ends with Jon being sent back to Winterfell, where he must face the consequences of his actions and try to rebuild his life.

Overall, this episode would focus on the character development of Jon Snow as he grapples with his past mistakes and tries to move forward in his new life as a member of the Stark family.
